title: A lane finds triage's session without searching recent sessions
why: Lane lane-lint-no-silent-pass could not find triage: no session tagged cs-build:triage for claude-settings showed in its 140 most recent sessions (coordinator, 20:35 CST Nov 7). A lane that cannot find triage cannot hand it a step change.
note: Measured by triage at 20:36 CST Nov 7: triage 6 (session_013NEJL42Sv3tJkjpzY7bExj) already carries the tags cs-build:triage and cs-repo:shivinate7/claude-settings. It was made on Nov 3, so it falls outside a search of the 140 most recent sessions. The tag is present, so the fix is the other half of the coordinator's pair: the lane brief carries triage's session id, or the search filters by tag rather than reading recent sessions. Coordinator starts a lane on the slug.
